ar.meaning: سَحَقَ الذَّهَبَ أَوِ الحَجَرَ الكَرِيمَ فِي الهَاوَنِ حَتَّى عَادَ دَقِيقًا نَاعِمًا

de.meaning: Goldflitter oder Mineralbrocken im Mörser zu staubfeinem Malpigment zermahlen

en.infinitive: to triturate / grind into impalpable powder
en.meaning: to grind gold leaf or mineral gems in a mortar into ultra-fine painter's pigment

conjugation_examples.ar: يَسْحَنُ المُذَهِّبُ كُتَلَ الّلازَوَرْدِ لِيَصْنَعَ مِنْهَا طِلاَءَ المُلُوكِ.
conjugation_examples.de: Der Illuminator verreibt Lapislazuli-Brocken, um königliche Ultramarinfarbe zu bereiten.
conjugation_examples.en: The illuminator triturates lapis lazuli lumps to produce royal ultramarine paint.

conjugation_examples.ar: سَحَنَ الصَّانِعُ الذَّهَبَ بِالعَسَلِ حَتَّى صَارَ كَالمَاءِ الصَّافِي.
conjugation_examples.de: Der Handwerker verrieb das Gold mit Honig, bis es so flüssig wie klares Wasser schien.
conjugation_examples.en: The artisan triturated the gold with honey until it appeared as fluid as clear water.
